meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 把消息里的本地附件(Word、演示文稿、表格、RTF、EPUB、CSV、文本型 PDF 等)在容器内转成本地 Markdown 文件,并打印输出路径;不上传到外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当你发来本地附件路径(如 /workspace/inbox/…),需要在不把文档上传到外部解析服务的前提下读取它时,这个技能会接管。

say.text: 把附件里的 Word 文档转成 Markdown
say.note: 转换在容器内本地完成并打印输出路径

say.text: 把 /workspace/inbox 里的这份 PDF 转成 Markdown
say.note: 文本型 PDF 可转,扫描件不支持
从标准输入读 CSV 时需指定 --format csv

howto.what_en: Turns a local attached file (Word, presentation, spreadsheet, RTF, EPUB, CSV, text-based PDF, etc.) into a local Markdown file inside the agent container, prints the output path, and never uploads the document to an external parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading the document to an external parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attached Word document to Markdown
say_en.note: Runs locally in the container and prints the output path

say_en.text: Turn the PDF at /workspace/inbox into Markdown
say_en.note: Text-based PDFs only; scanned files are unsupported
Reading CSV from stdin needs --format csv
